sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>

from collections import deque
def snap(fr):
    aa=fr.ascii.split('\n'); s=set(); N=[]; G=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(aa):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c in 'Ng' and (i,j) not in s:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); s.add((i,j)); pix=[]
                while q:
                    r,c2=q.popleft(); pix.append((r,c2))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c2+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(aa) and 0<=nc<len(aa[nr]) and aa[nr][nc]==c and (nr,nc) not in s:
                            s.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                rr=[p[0] for p in pix]; cc=[p[1] for p in pix]
                (N if c=='N' else G).append((min(cc),min(rr),len(pix)))
    return N,G
# reset via key
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':55,'col':6}])
N,G=snap(current_frame)
print('after key reset: N=',[(a[0],a[1]) for a in N],'key=','p' in current_frame.ascii)
# Now clean B-first: select only B, then move to idx0
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':24}])
N,G=snap(current_frame); print('select B: outline',[(a[0],a[1]) for a in G if a[2]<12])
action([{'action':'MOUSE','row':19,'col':12}])
N,G=snap(current_frame)
print('B->idx0: N=',[(a[0],a[1]) for a in N],'Gfull=',[(a[0],a[1]) for a in G if a[2]>=12],'key=','p' in current_frame.ascii)
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>

from collections import deque
def snap(fr):
    aa=fr.ascii.split('\n'); s=set(); N=[]; G=[]
    for i,row in enumerate(aa):
        for j,c in enumerate(row):
            if c in 'Ng' and (i,j) not in s:
                q=deque([(i,j)]); s.add((i,j)); pix=[]
                while q:
                    r,c2=q.popleft(); pix.append((r,c2))
                    for dr,dc in((1,0),(-1,0),(0,1),(0,-1)):
                        nr,nc=r+dr,c2+dc
                        if 0<=nr<len(aa) and 0<=nc<len(aa[nr]) and aa[nr][nc]==c and (nr,nc) not in s:
                            s.add((nr,nc)); q.append((nr,nc))
                rr=[p[0] for p in pix]; cc=[p[1] for p in pix]
                (N if c=='N' else G).append((min(cc),min(rr),len(pix)))
    return N,G
# reset via key
